title: Live stream DJI Osmo Action and Pocket to Instagram and TikTok
description: DJI Mimo can stream Osmo Action, Osmo Pocket and Osmo 360 cameras over RTMP. Send that to DJI Live Bridge to go live on Instagram, TikTok and YouTube at once.
h1: Live stream your DJI Osmo camera to Instagram, TikTok and more
lead: DJI Live Bridge is not only for drones. DJI's action and gimbal cameras stream over RTMP from the DJI Mimo app — exactly the kind of stream the app receives. Point an Osmo Action, Osmo Pocket or Osmo 360 at DJI Live Bridge and it goes to Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, Facebook, Twitch or Kick, several at once, in vertical or horizontal format — or into Zoom and OBS as a wireless webcam.
summary: DJI Mimo (version 1.2.20 or later) offers RTMP livestreaming on the Osmo Action, Osmo Pocket and Osmo 360 series.
The camera joins a Wi-Fi network itself and pushes RTMP; put it on the same network as the computer running DJI Live Bridge.
DJI Mimo's own platforms are Facebook, YouTube and RTMP — Instagram and TikTok are reached through DJI Live Bridge.
DJI lists 480p, 720p and 1080p at up to 6 Mbps; choose 1080p 6 Mbps when the Wi-Fi allows it.
The same stream can become a wireless webcam for TikTok LIVE Studio, OBS, Zoom or Meet.

blocks.p: According to DJI, these cameras support livestreaming in DJI Mimo, with RTMP as one of the platforms:

head: Camera
Resolutions (DJI)
Notes
rows: Osmo Pocket 3, Osmo Pocket 4, Osmo Pocket 4P
Osmo Action 6, Osmo Action 5 Pro, Osmo Action 4, Osmo Action 3
Action 2 also offers an adaptive bitrate

blocks.note: Not supported for livestreaming in DJI Mimo: the Osmo Mobile and DJI OM phone gimbals, the original Osmo Pocket and the Osmo Nano. With a phone gimbal, the phone itself is the camera.

sections.h2: Stream an Osmo camera through DJI Live Bridge

steps.d: Install DJI Live Bridge on a Mac or Windows PC. The Connect your drone step works for any RTMP camera and shows an address like rtmp://192.168.1.20:1935/drone.

steps.t: Connect the camera in DJI Mimo
steps.d: Update DJI Mimo to 1.2.20 or later, connect the camera and open its livestream option.
Select RTMP as the platform and pick the Wi-Fi network the camera should use — the same one the computer is on, or a phone hotspot both have joined.
Type the address from DJI Live Bridge, choose 1080p and the highest bitrate your Wi-Fi handles, and start. The preview appears in the app within seconds.
Add Instagram, TikTok, YouTube or any RTMP server, choose vertical or horizontal, and press START LIVE.

blocks.alt: The Go live tab of DJI Live Bridge with the RTMP address, the destinations and the START LIVE button.

sections.h2: What it adds to an Osmo camera

list: Instagram and TikTok. DJI Mimo streams to Facebook, YouTube or an RTMP address; DJI Live Bridge reaches Instagram over RTMPS and TikTok with a stream key or through TikTok LIVE Studio.
Several platforms at once. One camera, the same broadcast on Instagram, TikTok and YouTube.
Vertical for phones. A landscape picture becomes 1080×1920 with a blurred fill instead of black bars.
A wireless webcam. The built-in virtual camera shows the Osmo's picture in TikTok LIVE Studio, OBS, Zoom or Meet — no cable to the computer. See the webcam guide.
Preview and recording. Watch the real input on the computer and record it while you stream.
The camera cannot connect: it must be on the same network as the computer. Guest networks often isolate devices; use a normal Wi-Fi or a hotspot.
No livestream option in DJI Mimo: update DJI Mimo and the camera firmware; livestreaming needs DJI Mimo 1.2.20 or later.
The picture stutters: lower the bitrate in DJI Mimo or move the camera closer to the router.
Osmo 360 does not stream: switch it to single-lens mode first.

faq.q: Can I live stream an Osmo Action or Osmo Pocket to Instagram?
faq.a: Not from DJI Mimo alone, which offers Facebook, YouTube and RTMP. Stream to DJI Live Bridge over RTMP and it forwards the picture to Instagram over RTMPS.

faq.q: Does DJI Live Bridge work with cameras, not just drones?
faq.a: Yes. It receives a standard RTMP stream, whether DJI Fly or DJI Mimo sends it.

faq.q: Which DJI cameras support RTMP livestreaming?
faq.a: Per DJI: Osmo Pocket 3, 4 and 4P, Osmo Action 3, 4, 5 Pro and 6, the Osmo 360 series in single-lens mode, DJI Pocket 2, DJI Action 2 and the first Osmo Action.

faq.q: Can I use an Osmo camera as a wireless webcam?
faq.a: Yes. Start DJI Live Bridge's virtual camera and pick DJI Live Bridge Camera in TikTok LIVE Studio, OBS, Zoom or Meet.
Yes. DJI Live Bridge is free and open source, and is not affiliated with DJI.
